steps.name: Check META_API_KEY not hardcoded
steps.run: grep -rE '(META_API_KEY|LLM_|sk-|vcp_|nfp_|rnd_|hf_)[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{10,}' backend/ frontend/api/ frontend/src/ --include='*.py' --include='*.js' --include='*.jsx' | grep -v 'process.env' | grep -v 'os.getenv' | grep -v 'getenv' && echo 'WARNING: possible hardcoded secret' || echo 'OK: no hardcoded secrets found'
